audit_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2H-B - Observability & Incident Controls Specification
audit_metadata.auditor_role: Site Reliability Reviewer & Risk Governance Officer

INFORMATIONAL.definition: Normal operational events, heartbeats, and rebalance audit trails. No operational action required.
conditions: Daily causal rebalance completed at T close.
Opening fill confirmation at T+1 open.
Settled cash reconciliation with 0.0000 residual.
Daily paired shortfall metric Delta S_t recorded.
INFORMATIONAL.action: Logged to append-only immutable audit log.

WARNING.definition: Anomalous event within tolerable bounds. Automated retry or operator notification; execution continues.
conditions: Execution slippage between 10 bps and 25 bps.
Market data feed delay > 1 minute but < 5 minutes.
Upcoming corporate action announced within 3 days.
Portfolio tracking error divergence > 150 bps annualized.
Data provider rate limit usage > 80% of tier quota.
WARNING.action: Emit operator warning alert; record diagnostic in incident journal.

CRITICAL.definition: Material anomaly threatening evaluation integrity or financial bounds. Requires same-day operator investigation.
conditions: Cash residual between $0.0001 and $0.01.
Single-day strategy drawdown > 3.0%.
Data provider query timeout after 3 exponential backoff retries.
Market data stale (> 15 minutes past market close).
Late event arrival after decision window closure (quarantined).
D2 cumulative drawdown exceeds E0 cumulative drawdown by > 200 bps.
CRITICAL.action: Quarantine affected event; freeze pending rebalances; notify operator.

HARD_STOP.definition: Severe integrity, security, or accounting breach. Halts execution immediately and writes persistent state file to disk. Survives process restarts; cannot be cleared without explicit owner override key.
conditions: Unauthorized activation attempt or missing cryptographic token.
Protected source hash mismatch (agent.py, universe.json, comparator).
Balance sheet identity violation: |Assets - Liabilities - Equity| > $0.01.
Negative cash balance detected (cash < 0.00).
Directory traversal or sealed Tier 3 observation access attempt.
Corrupt checkpoint or event journal HMAC verification failure.
Data license expiration or legal redistribution revocation.
D2 cumulative drawdown underperforms E0 by > 300 bps (evaluation failure gate).
HARD_STOP.persistence_mechanism: State written to .v30_stage2h_b_hard_stop_state.json. Engine startup unconditionally fails closed until manual execution of clear_hard_stop_manual() by owner.
HARD_STOP.action: Immediate halt; zero order emission; persistent disk lock; emergency owner notification.

monitoring_server_policy: NO RUNNING WEBSERVER DEPLOYED. Monitoring is provided via static versioned HTML dashboard mockup and local JSON telemetry.
